verdict.rationale: Crossplane ships a documented official CLI (docs.crossplane.io/cli/latest/) covering building/testing/rendering compositions, installing/updating/pushing packages, and troubleshooting resources — all scriptable and usable in automated/agentic pipelines. missing for 10: no explicit AI-agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., structured machine-readable output tailored for LLM agents) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of CLI usage in agentic workflows.
